title: Pokemon RAG AI Agent: LLM Knowledge Retrieval System
description: Built a RAG-powered conversational AI agent over a structured Pokemon knowledge base; implemented end-to-end document ingestion, text chunking, and vector embedding pipelines using LangChain and ChromaDB; designed semantic retrieval with dense vector search and prompt-engineered LLM responses for multi-turn question answering.

title: NYC Citi Bike Analysis: Demand Forecasting & Rebalancing
description: Built a tested Python pipeline (pandas, PyArrow, Shapely) that cleans 44M+ 2024 Citi Bike trips and joins NOAA weather and NYC bike lane data to answer where bikes run out, and when. Forecast next-day hourly demand at 2,296 stations with Poisson gradient boosting (scikit-learn): 86–94% citywide daily accuracy, station-hour error 11–17% below the best baseline, and 3 of 3 monthly backtests won. Sized the rebalancing problem at 5,927+ bikes stranded each weekday morning across 676 draining and 409 filling stations; found commute-hour rain cuts rides 29% (95% CI 22–32%) vs. 7% for off-peak rain. Published an interactive site with Leaflet maps, SVG charts, and 80% conformal prediction bands; CI runs leak tests and checks every reported number against the data. Added a member vs. casual rider classifier on leak-free features (ROC-AUC 0.77) and regression with 14-day block-bootstrap intervals for weather effects.

title: Organ Trail: Interactive Surgery Data Explorer
description: Built a D3.js scrollytelling site with a team of 3 over 6,000+ hospital surgery cases, showing how patient age and surgical position relate to operation type and duration; added an interactive duration estimator from filtered case averages so non-technical users can explore trends without writing code.

title: Reddit NLP Pipeline: Deep Learning Text Generation
description: Trained and evaluated a character-level deep learning model in TensorFlow on unstructured corpora from Reddit’s top 200 communities; designed a benchmarking framework comparing architectural configurations against perplexity metrics; authored paper analyzing domain-specific language pattern capture.

title: Amazon Purchase Dataset: Large-Scale ML Pipeline
description: Engineered distributed ML pipelines with AWS Lambda, EC2, and Apache Spark to ingest and clean 16M+ rows of Amazon purchase data. Implemented one-hot encoding, distributed PCA, and feature engineering in BigQuery to reduce dimensionality for downstream models. Optimized batch calculation of RMSE across the full dataset to evaluate models at scale.

title: Seal Health Modeling: Human Impact on Alaskan Seals
description: Merged four NOAA and Alaska Fish & Game datasets to test whether ocean-economy activity predicts Alaskan seal health; re-validated the original ridge model (R² 0.91 on a 3-row test split) with leave-one-out cross-validation across 5 models and permutation importance, showing the fit did not generalize on 13 yearly observations and reporting that openly.

title: San Diego Parking Meter Analytics Dashboard
description: Developed a geospatial analytics dashboard using D3.js to visualize 100,000+ parking meter citations across San Diego; created interactive daily frequency histograms and a geospatial heat map enabling drivers to identify optimal parking times and locations.

title: Autonomous Vehicle Development: 1st Place at Purdue
description: Designed and deployed CNN-based perception and control models for autonomous vehicle navigation on low-power embedded hardware, integrating stereo and RGB-D cameras for real-time 3D scene understanding; benchmarked against LLMs and LVMs and won 1st place at Purdue's national autonomous vehicle competition.

title: Scripps Climate Research
description: Built Python ETL pipelines to analyze 70+ years of climate data from 60 coastal airports. Used sliding-window PCA, polynomial regression, and ridge regression to link urbanization to reduced cloud cover and higher local temperatures, contributing to a peer-reviewed publication update.

title: Deloitte Substance Abuse Risk Analysis
description: Trained XGBoost and regularized regression models on 50,000+ HHS records, identifying proximity to low-income neighborhoods and gambling advertisements as top predictors of substance abuse risk. Turned model results into strategic recommendations and presented them to senior Deloitte leadership through interactive Seaborn and Plotly dashboards.
